items.article_text: Hey folks, curious if anyone has insight into why Canada Life Place dropped off the map as a prominent concert venue in Canada? I recognize that COVID had an impact on touring, and a post about CLP last year had many comments about ticket prices. But we get very few artists coming here anymore. We once had Elton John, Pearl Jam, PRINCE for god’s sake. I assume for large acts like the ones I just mentioned it’s just not financially viable with the cost of tour productions so they do Detroit and Toronto. But we don’t even really get mid-sized tours any more, they go to Windsor, Niagara, Hamilton, or Kitchener.
